candidates.text: <prompt>Identify the option that best represents the clinical judgment of an experienced practitioner, emphasizing evidence-based decision-making and the avoidance of misleading or irrelevant choices.</prompt>

Focus on the most critical diagnostic clues in medical multiple-choice questions. Prioritize key clinical findings and eliminate non-essential details. Use this focused approach to select the best answer.

<prompt>Consider how the pathophysiology of the condition informs the most appropriate therapeutic approach, ensuring your choice reflects both scientific rationale and established clinical practice.</prompt>
<prompt>Which answer best illustrates the application of evidence-based reasoning to evaluate diagnostic possibilities and select the most appropriate therapeutic approach?</prompt>
<prompt>Focus on the most reliable and contextually appropriate choice, considering how the patient's age, gender, or prior medical conditions may affect the interpretation of the options.</prompt>
<prompt>Focus on the most clinically valid and evidence-based answer, ensuring it reflects both the biological basis of the condition and the standard of care in modern practice.</prompt>
<prompt>Choose the option that aligns with both the biological basis of the condition and the practical application of current medical standards in diagnosing and managing patients.</prompt>

<prompt>Focus on the most salient detail in the question and align your answer with both the best clinical practice and the most frequently tested approaches in medical licensing assessments.</prompt>

Use a methodical approach to dissect medical multiple-choice questions by isolating the key diagnostic features. Focus on the most defining characteristics of the condition or scenario presented in the question.
In medical multiple-choice question-answering, emphasize the most specific and relevant clinical findings that lead to the correct diagnosis. Avoid over-reliance on general or commonly known facts.

<prompt>Use your knowledge of standard treatment protocols to guide your answer, ensuring that your choice is grounded in both the disease mechanism and the evidence-based interventions typically taught in medical training.</prompt>

<prompt>Use your knowledge of standard medical education materials to select the option that best matches the typical approach taught in residency training and licensing exams, ensuring that your choice is both accurate and representative of current clinical norms.</prompt>
<prompt>Base your choice on the integration of pathophysiological principles and the standard treatment protocols used in contemporary medical practice.</prompt>
<prompt>Focus on the essential diagnostic elements while considering how the condition typically evolves and responds to treatment.</prompt>

<prompt>Organize your reasoning around the chronological order of treatment phases as defined by authoritative medical sources. Choose the option that best fits the phase most often highlighted in licensing exam settings.

<prompt>Use your knowledge of how diseases progress at the cellular and systemic levels to inform your choice, ensuring your answer reflects both the mechanism of disease and the standard of care.</prompt>
Use a structured approach to dissect medical questions by isolating key diagnostic features. Focus on the most impactful clinical findings and use them to determine the most accurate response.

<prompt>Consider the interplay between disease pathogenesis and treatment strategies, selecting the answer that most accurately reflects the relationship between biological processes and clinical practice.</prompt>
<prompt>Use the question's key clinical feature to guide your reasoning and select the option that best represents the standard of care and the most effective management strategy.</prompt>
<prompt>Choose the option that best integrates the patient's age, gender, and medical history with the most current and effective treatment guidelines.</prompt>
